name: 爱尔兰关键技能就业许可
summary: 面向取得至少两年爱尔兰工作邀请、且职业和薪酬符合关键技能许可规则的非欧洲经济区人士。
summaryEn: For non-EEA nationals with an Irish job offer of at least two years that meets the Critical Skills occupation and remuneration rules.

jobOffer.summary: 工作邀请须由真实、在爱尔兰经营的雇主提供，期限至少两年。
jobOffer.summaryEn: A bona fide employer trading in Ireland must offer employment for at least two years.

occupation.summary: 职业、资格和薪酬组合须属于关键技能许可的合资格范围。
occupation.summaryEn: The occupation, qualifications and remuneration must fall within an eligible Critical Skills category.

salary.summary: 须达到申请时适用于该职业类别的薪酬标准。
salary.summaryEn: The remuneration threshold applicable to the occupation category at the time of application must be met.

sources.authority: Ireland Department of Enterprise, Tourism and Employment
sources.title: Critical Skills Employment Permit

disclaimer: 本资料仅供一般教育用途，不构成个性化移民或法律建议。
